scope_notes.RCON: Single observer, raw command bodies retained; native shared console bodies have no request-specific business nonce.
scope_notes.failure: No replay of unknown input/extraction, no automatic flags restore/stop/cleanup/force kill. Keep last actual configuration and assets for operator diagnosis.
scope_notes.cleanup: Keep the four validated empty devices and own vanilla load tickets on success for parent normal stop; no world deletion.
